week.name: This Afternoon
week.detailed: A slight chance of rain after 5pm. Mostly cloudy. High near 60, with temperatures falling to around 56 in the afternoon. South wind 3 to 8 mph. Chance of precipitation is 20%.

week.name: Saturday
week.detailed: Rain before 8am, then rain and snow between 8am and 5pm. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 46. Northwest wind around 2 mph. Chance of precipitation is 100%. New rainfall amounts between a tenth and quarter of an inch possible.

week.name: Sunday
week.detailed: Mostly sunny, with a high near 53. South southwest wind around 3 mph.

week.name: Monday
week.detailed: Mostly sunny, with a high near 55.

week.name: Tuesday
week.detailed: Rain. Cloudy, with a high near 48.

week.name: Wednesday
week.detailed: A chance of snow before 11am, then a chance of rain and snow. Partly sunny, with a high near 42. Little or no snow accumulation expected.

week.name: Thursday
week.detailed: Snow likely before 11am, then rain and snow likely. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 41. New snow accumulation of less than half an inch possible.
